First public release of the **MARK 1 SPECTRE**, a pocket cyberpunk cyberdeck for the **Samsung Galaxy S10e** and the **Rii Mini X1** keyboard.

### Downloads
- **`MARK1_SPECTRE_v1.0_STL.zip`**: every printable part, split into folders in print order (1 → 6). Includes the fit and mechanism test jigs and both the plain and the AMS (orange lettering) versions of the base and lid.
- **`MARK1_SPECTRE_v1.0_STEP.zip`**: STEP files for editing in any CAD program.
- **Source code (zip / tar.gz)**: the parametric CadQuery script, so you can adapt the model to other phones.

### Print settings
- PETG or ASA, 0.2 mm layers, 4 walls, 25–30 % infill.
- **No supports.**
- Tested on a Bambu Lab A1.

### Hardware
- 2 × M3×40 socket head screws (DIN 912).
- 2 × M3 nuts.

### What's in v1.0
- **Opening angle:** 130° (was 115°).
- **Keyboard pocket:** uses the KeyboardTray outline, with a floor slot for the bump on the back of the Rii.
- **Power button:** positioned from the official S10e drawing. It sticks out 1 mm and has less play.
- **Camera window:** centred on the S10e camera bar.
- **Phone fit:** tighter, with 4 floor pads that stop the phone from rattling.
- **Lock tab:** larger and ribbed, so you can work it with a finger.
- **Neon bars:** front only (no side bars).

📱 Want it for another phone? [Open a request](https://github.com/LoganxWrath/mark1-spectre/issues/new?template=new_phone.yml).
